identity.summary: UFC lists the St. Gallen bantamweight (judo black belt) with the title 'U23 European champion 2010', which matches Swiss judoka Stephanie EGGER (IJF person 4115, women's −70 kg).

national.note: Identity confirmed through the UFC bio's 'U23 European champion 2010' (European U23 Championships, Sarajevo 2010, women's −70 kg, for Switzerland). The European Judo Union report of that title could not be opened directly (404), so it is not yet a claim. IJF entrant data lists her at the 2011 Paris Grand Slam (−70 kg, lost her first contest), but her IJF athlete page shows a 2011 Prague World Cup contest instead. Resolve with the EJU 2010 U23 results page or the IJF results for both 2011 events.
